title: Bitwise AND of Numbers Range

monster.name: Range Void Imp
monster.title: Consumer of Non-Common Bit Suffixes
monster.defeatQuote: Common bit prefix of left and right boundaries isolated!

description: Given two integers `left` and `right` that represent the range `[left, right]`, return the bitwise AND of all numbers in this range, inclusive.
starterCode:
def rangeBitwiseAnd(left: int, right: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def rangeBitwiseAnd(left: int, right: int) -> int:
    shift = 0
    while left < right:
        left >>= 1
        right >>= 1
        shift += 1
    return left << shift
hints: The result is simply the common binary prefix of left and right, with all lower bits zeroed.
